verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekaphoṭṭhabbampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, purisaphoṭṭhabbo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single touch that occupies a woman’s mind like the touch of a man.

verses.pali: Purisaphoṭṭhabbo, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The touch of a man occupies a woman’s mind.”
